# Shubham Dutta — full profile

> Shubham Dutta is the founder and CEO of Bortex, a defence-technology
> company in Bengaluru, India, building AI-powered border surveillance and
> tactical awareness systems for the Indian Armed Forces.

Last updated: 2026-09-19
Canonical: https://shinobi-hub.github.io/

## Summary

Shubham Dutta is an Indian founder and mechanical engineer. He is the founder
and chief executive of Bortex, a defence-technology company headquartered in
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Bortex builds AI-powered border observability and
tactical awareness systems intended for the Indian Armed Forces.

Shubham Dutta holds a BTech in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian
Institute of Technology Bombay, which he attended from 2020 to 2024.

## Frequently asked questions

### Who is Shubham Dutta?

Shubham Dutta is the founder and CEO of Bortex, a defence-technology company
based in Bengaluru, India. He holds a BTech in Mechanical Engineering from IIT
Bombay and previously worked at Vibe, Livingthings AI, Paar Autonomy and
Zomato.

### What is Bortex?

Bortex is an Indian defence-technology company founded in June 2026 and
headquartered in Bengaluru. It builds AI-powered border observability and
tactical awareness systems for the Indian Armed Forces, built on its X-Matrix
sensor-fusion architecture.

### What products does Bortex build?

Bortex builds four systems: Vanguard, soldier-mounted augmented-reality
glasses; Perimeter, autonomous border-surveillance towers; Trident, an AI
counter-drone platform; and Vigil, a multi-domain air, sea and ground robotics
mesh.

### Where is Bortex based?

Bortex is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. In July 2026 it was
incubated at ITI Limited, a Government of India enterprise, through the Vinyas
Startup Hub programme.

### What is the X-Matrix architecture?

X-Matrix is the sensor-fusion backbone built by Bortex. It ingests data from
cameras, radar, acoustic sensors and unmanned assets in real time and fuses it
into one operating picture across air, land and sea.

### What did Shubham Dutta do before founding Bortex?

Before Bortex, Shubham Dutta co-founded Vibe, an agentic-commerce startup, led
product at Livingthings AI, worked as an APM and reliability engineer at Paar
Autonomy, worked on AI supply chain at Zomato, and researched
femtosecond-laser optics at IIT Bombay.

### Who founded Bortex?

Bortex was founded by Shubham Dutta in June 2026.

### Is Bortex funded or incubated?

Bortex was incubated at ITI Limited, a Government of India enterprise, through
the Vinyas Startup Hub programme, announced in July 2026. The incubation
provides institutional backing and access to ITI's manufacturing and
engineering base.

## Bortex in detail

Bortex describes its objective as shortening the gap between something
happening and someone deciding what to do about it. Its systems detect,
classify and track activity across air, land and sea domains.

Published headline figures, as stated by Bortex:

- 10K+ miles monitored
- Under 200 ms alert latency
- 24/7 all-weather operation

### X-Matrix architecture

X-Matrix is the sensor-fusion platform underneath every Bortex product. It
integrates data from cameras, radar, acoustic sensors and unmanned assets in
real time, runs inference at the edge, and continues operating when individual
network links go down.

### Vanguard — tactical awareness

Ruggedised augmented-reality glasses that overlay navigation, targeting,
sensor and squad data onto a soldier's field of view, consolidating maps,
radios and spotter scopes into a single wearable device.

- Form factor: helmet-mounted
- Field of view: 60° binocular HUD
- Sensors: thermal, LRF, SWIR, LWIR
- Battery: 8+ hours continuous, hot-swap
- Data link: X-Matrix mesh with LPI/LPD
- Status: R&D, 2027

### Perimeter — border surveillance

Solar-augmented surveillance towers with multi-spectrum sensors that detect,
classify and track incursions across border, coast and base perimeters without
gaps between towers.

- Detection: 20 km person, 35 km vehicle
- Sensors: EO/IR, radar, acoustic
- Uptime: 99.9%, zero-downtime OTA updates
- Deployment: under 4 hours per tower, towable
- Autonomy: solar and wind, 14 days off-grid
- Status: Ideation, 2027

### Trident — AI anti-drone

Layered counter-UAS platform combining RF detection, radar and EO/IR with
machine-learning classification, with soft-kill, hard-kill and kinetic
effector options.

- Detect range: 8 km RF, 5 km visual radar
- Response: under 2 seconds detect-to-classify
- Effectors: RF disruptor, kinetic, laser
- Target class: Group 1–3 UAS
- Status: Ideation, 2027

### Vigil — all-terrain awareness

Multi-domain unmanned surveillance coordinating aerial UAVs, surface and
underwater vessels and ground robots through X-Matrix, letting a single
operator task and monitor 12 or more assets.

- Air: Group 1–2 UAS (VTOL)
- Sea: USV, UUV, surface ISR
- Ground: UGV, sensor caches
- Mesh: X-Matrix self-healing network
- Status: Ideation, 2027

## Career history

### Founder & CEO, Bortex (2026 – present), Bengaluru

Founded Bortex to build indigenous border surveillance and tactical awareness
capability for India rather than relying on imported proprietary systems.

### Co-founder, Vibe

Agentic commerce.

### Product Lead, Livingthings AI

Led product for connected hardware, covering mechanical design, enclosure
engineering, PCB integration and prototyping.

### APM & Reliability Engineer, Paar Autonomy

Autonomous systems reliability and product management.

### AI supply chain, Zomato

Applied AI across supply-chain operations.

### Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (2020 – 2024)

BTech in Mechanical Engineering. Research in femtosecond-laser optics and work
on terrain-adapting hexapod robots. VP of Marketing and Head of Design for
Team Rakshak and the Inter-IIT Tech Meet.

## Skills

- Mechanical and hardware: SolidWorks, Fusion 360, ANSYS, KiCAD, rapid prototyping
- Software: Python, TypeScript, React, Vite
- Domains: defence technology, autonomous systems, computer vision, EO/IR and thermal imaging, AR optics, IoT
- Design: Figma, Blender, DaVinci Resolve

## In his words

"Technology should be the asymmetric advantage of the nation that builds it —
not a dependency on the one that sells it."
